events.title: Choppy Waters is in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hi there! Choppy Waters is part of Steam Next fest this week! 🎉 If you haven't tried it yet, it's a roguelite deckbuilder where you craft your own cards from sushi ingredients and feed them to hungry pirate cats. The demo is free to play, and honestly already has a lot of content you can try out (A small portion of what will be included in the full game of course). events.title: Choppy Waters Next Fest Gameplay Stream
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here, and the Choppy Waters demo is free to play! Watch me play the demo during the festival, and if it looks interesting, try it yourself :) I'm a solo dev, and I'm very happy with the current state of the demo. If you agree, please consider wishlisting, it helps me out a ton!
